# Continue the binding and mathematical optimization

The completed adapter and the six matched pairs are described in README.md. Do not rerun them merely to reconnect a dialogue. First read IMPLEMENTATION_SCOPE.md and both execution notes to distinguish fixed-bank acceptance, logical full comparisons, actual old-method calls, scientific observations and host encoding costs. The canonical-wrapper gate is necessary to the current proof; removing it needs a new argument and versioned implementation.

The deterministic next engineering question is whether the same complete immutable segments can be safely shared across engines using one admitted bank. Every current token independently retains 707,035 segment payload bytes, while every constructor still checks the real bank and derives its token. A candidate may separate immutable bank-derived segments from engine-specific identity bindings, retaining exact bank object/source/canonical-view checks and unchanged fallback semantics. This is unimplemented. Shared storage is not permission to trust mutable caller metadata or omit program checks. Measure actual constructor and retained-byte changes only after a reviewed correctness contract; preserve all costs and results.

The mathematical priority is independent of metadata encoding: reduce the cost and growth of actual signed correlation queries. The endpoint sibling source EM 17eda578c2e32f5a86bf71e28181850fcd0bd5b3, research_notes/directed_recovery/20260927_C6438C/qft_gap_shortcuts/, preserves 31 exact scalar answers at 68,824 production digit replays. Its three interior cases still cost 65,034. Its next_design directory gives the complete direct difference-autocorrelation proof and peer review. It reduces one single-bit query to at most four top-level degree-three floor-moment tables, with two oriented magnitude progressions and exact divisions by two and six. This is a successor candidate, not an executed result of the present binding package. Cheap old special cases can beat the new formula, so record every case rather than only improvements.

For broader QFT work, scalar signed-gap compression must connect to the full operator/carry contract and actual selected temporal words. Existing order/address discovery remains paid, and arbitrary masks or multi-gap matrix growth are not solved by these engineering results. The SO trace bound and earlier full-history assessment are in the pinned trace parent. No constant active-history theorem is assumed.

Any dialogue can continue from these equations, source contracts and explicit open questions. A particular machine, model role or connector is not a prerequisite for symbolic work. Use available tools to recover immutable evidence when possible; if unavailable, identify the implementation fact that remains unverified and continue work supported by the visible mathematics. Do not invent an observation. Preserve new executable results, failures, costs and continuation in a new source version rather than changing this frozen record.
